# clickhouse_service_profiles (Data Source)

List the custom instance profiles available to the organization in a given
region, e.g. dynamic BYOC profiles like `v1-standard-byoc-4`. Pass `byoc_id`
to include the profiles configured for that BYOC infrastructure — BYOC
profiles are only returned when it is set. The `profile` value can be passed
to the `profile` attribute of the `clickhouse_service` resource. Returns an
empty list when no custom profiles are available (e.g. non-ENTERPRISE,
non-BYOC organization tiers). Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Custom instance profiles available in a region
data "clickhouse_service_profiles" "us_east_1" {
  region_id = "us-east-1"
}

# Include dynamic BYOC profiles configured for a BYOC infrastructure
data "clickhouse_service_profiles" "byoc" {
  region_id = "us-east-1"
  byoc_id   = var.byoc_id
}

output "available_profiles" {
  value = data.clickhouse_service_profiles.byoc.profiles
}

# Use a discovered profile to create a service
resource "clickhouse_service" "byoc" {
  name           = "byoc-service"
  cloud_provider = "aws"
  region         = "us-east-1"
  byoc_id        = var.byoc_id

  profile               = data.clickhouse_service_profiles.byoc.profiles[0].profile
  min_replica_memory_gb = data.clickhouse_service_profiles.byoc.profiles[0].memory_gi
  max_replica_memory_gb = data.clickhouse_service_profiles.byoc.profiles[0].memory_gi
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_id` (String) Region to list available profiles for (e.g. 'us-east-1').

### Optional

- `byoc_id` (String) BYOC infrastructure ID. Required to include dynamic BYOC profiles in the result.

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) Custom instance profiles available to the organization in the given region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_cores` (Number) Number of CPU cores per replica.
- `memory_gi` (Number) Memory per replica in GiB. For BYOC profiles, 'min_replica_memory_gb' and 'max_replica_memory_gb' on the service must both equal this value.
- `profile` (String) Profile name, usable as the 'profile' attribute of the clickhouse_service resource.
